label: The recommendation's carrier line must move from AGENTS.md:186 to AGENTS.md:176: line 183 ends at byte 16357 and is the last fully delivered line, line 184 is severed at 16384, and line 186 starts at byte 16889 and is wholly absent on Devin. Line 176 occupies bytes 15324-15458 and is fully delivered with 926 bytes of margin.

No plan-shape or review-verdict obligation exists in AGENTS.md lines 1-183: the only plan hits are PLAN-WORKFLOW LOCK at lines 22 and 26-27 (scoped to plans that name a workflow), Gate 4's routing tiebreaker at line 89, and 'rerun the objective proof plan' at line 134. The requirement therefore has no delivered carrier today.

The 16384-byte cut binds injected rule files, not documents opened by a tool read: AGENTS.md (27372 bytes), SKILL.md (28185) and ROUTER.md (26012) all exceed it, but only AGENTS.md is injected as a rule, so M2 and M4 do not inherit the truncation and the card (9699 bytes) is under the limit regardless.

A second always-injected carrier exists and is ruled unnecessary: .cursor/rules/skill-routing.md is 2257 bytes and Devin inherits the repo's Cursor rules, but line 176 already serves every runtime that receives AGENTS.md, so a third file would only reach DSH, which reads neither AGENTS.md nor Cursor rules.

Re-ranked recommendation: M1 (AGENTS.md:176 plus card 123-124, ~28-30 tokens per turn, 6 of 7 runtimes, pre-edit, can carry a reader verdict) > M4 (templates plus validate.sh, 0 tokens, 7 of 7, post-implementation, decidable shape only) > M3 (hook, 0-512 tokens, 6 of 7, prompt time only) > M2 (shared reference, pointer plus 256-512 when loaded, load-dependent) > M5 (invoke the command, 15025-23374 per invocation, 5 of 7, needs a user). M1 leads on position, M4 is the only 7-of-7 carrier, so the two are a pair and not redundant.

Exact edit set: three existing lines in two existing files, no new file, hook, command, agent or numbered gate. AGENTS.md:176 gains the Level 2+ phase-anchoring and review-verdict clause with the AI_SESSION_CHILD=1 record-and-continue qualifier; spec-authoring-card.md:113 gains the same Level 2+ qualifier; spec-authoring-card.md:123-124 replace the heading-presence acceptance and the rg '^## 4' verify with a check that can fail on an unanchored phase line.

The anchor move has a budget consequence: about 110 characters (~28 tokens) added on the 6 runtimes that carry AGENTS.md, which cuts line 176's margin to the 16384-byte boundary from 926 to roughly 816 bytes, making the clause length the binding constraint on the wording.
A recommendation that names a line must name a line inside the carrier's injected byte budget on every runtime that injects it; a line past the cut is not a cheaper edit, it is an absent one.
